verdict.rationale: Docs show fallback chains (sequential provider/model failover on error/timeout) and Dynamic Routing that supports conditions, quotas, and A/B/gradual rollouts across providers/models, which implies weight-based traffic splitting. However, there is no explicit documentation of latency-based or cost-based routing decisions—cost data is only surfaced via metrics/logging, not used as a routing criterion. Missing for 10: explicit latency-based routing logic, explicit cost-based routing logic, and independent/hands-on confirmation of weighted load-balancing behavior in production.
